Name: Enrage
Description: Once you become Bloodied, gain +1 damage on all Attacks

Name: Opportunist
Description: Deal +1 on Heavy Hits to creatures affected by at least one Condition.

Name: Pack Tactics
Description: Gain an additional +2 bonus to Attacks while Flanking a creature.

Name: Unrelenting
Description: The only way you can be reduced below 1 HP is by a Heavy Hit or an Attack that deals Radiant damage.

Name: Regeneration
Description: Heal 1 HP at the start of each of your turns.

Name: Death's Door
Description: This monster can use the Death's Door mechanic like PCs, making near-fatal situations more dramatic and strategic.

Name: Shot Caller
Description: When you use the Help Action on another creature, its next Attack deals +1 damage.

Name: Inspire
Description: Once per turn, give a Help Die to an allied creature for free.

Name: False Appearance
Description: While motionless, you're indistinguishable from a specified object.

Name: Attribute Increase
Description: Attribute Increase: +1 to 1 Attribute (up to Prime Modifier).

Name: Attribute Decrease
Description: Attribute Decrease: -1 to 1 Attribute (minimum of -5).

Name: Damage Increase
Description: The damage increases based on its Level as shown in the Damage Change Table. This is roughly a 25% increase in damage.

Name: Damage Decrease
Description: The damage decreases based on its Level as shown in the Damage Change Table. This is roughly a 25% decrease in damage.

Name: Defense Increase
Description: +1 to 1 Defense

Name: Defense Decrease
Description: -1 to 1 Defense

Name: Speed Increase
Description: +3 Speed

Name: Speed Decrease
Description: -1 Speed

Name: Fly Speed
Description: Fly Speed equal to Speed

Name: Burrow Speed
Description: Burrow Speed equal to Speed

Name: Swim Speed
Description: Swim Speed equal to Speed and can breath underwater

Name: Climb Speed
Description: Climb Speed equal to Speed and Resistance (Half) to Falling Damage

Name: Truewalk
Description: You can walk normally on solid surfaces regardless of their orientation (such as upside down on the ceiling) without falling or needing to Climb.

Name: Incorporeal
Description: You can move through solid objects and creatures. If you end your turn inside an object or creature, you take True damage equal to 25% of your maximum HP.

Name: Darkvision
Description: Darkvision 10 Spaces

Name: Tremorsense
Description: Tremorsense 3 Spaces

Name: Blindsight
Description: Blindsight 3 Spaces

Name: Truesight
Description: Truesight 10 Spaces

Name: Damage Reduction
Description: Damage Reduction to Physical, Elemental, or Mystical damage.

Name: Resistance
Description: Resistance (Half) to 1 damage type.

Name: Vulnerability
Description: Vulnerability (Double) to 1 damage type.

Name: Immunity
Description: Immunity to 1 damage type.

Name: Absorption
Description: Immunity to 1 damage type and regain HP equal to 1/2 damage.

Name: ADV on Skill Checks
Description: ADV on 1 Skill Check (such as Awareness, Athletics, or Trickery).

Name: DisADV on Skill Checks
Description: DisADV on 1 Skill Check (such as Awareness, Athletics, or Trickery).

Name: ADV on Attribute Save
Description: ADV on 1 Attribute Save (Might, Agility, Intelligence, or Charisma).

Name: DisADV on Attribute Save
Description: DisADV on 1 Attribute Save (Might, Agility, Intelligence, or Charisma).

Name: Condition Resistance
Description: ADV on Checks & Saves against 1 Condition

Name: Condition Vulnerability
Description: DisADV on Checks & Saves against 1 Condition

Name: Condition Immunity
Description: Immunity to 1 Condition
